correctness.rationale: Exact cyclic Gram entries and their periodized cardinal inverse are reconstructed algebraically. Linear segment integration gives the exact operator norm, and convexity plus strict sign disagreement proves the norming-knot classification. The cardinal absolute integral equals 2; two-translate splitting and exponential decay give the O(q^(2m)) remainder after local scaling. Two explicit piecewise-affine overlap integrals produce the distinct even and odd coefficient series. The standalone exact-rational checker ran successfully for 19 mesh sizes and independently recomputed overlap coefficients; the analytic proof, not the finite tests, establishes all n and asymptotics.

value.rationale: For a canonical least-squares finite-element projector, the exact finite-mesh amplification and two unequal exponential convergence coefficients characterize how periodic boundary closure and mesh parity affect sharp L∞ stability. The natural operator norm, all finite n, strict norming locations and explicit asymptotic constants form a motivated complete finite-period problem rather than an arbitrary subcase.
